answer: A newcomer in the meadow can't cheaply flood the grove of established peers, since every duplicate identity needs fresh collateral. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed influence, so spinning up fake identities is costly. When a gale of sockpuppets arrives, honest nodes simply outweight them by verified stake, and slashing burns attackers' bonds on proven fraud. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
